articles.title: James Baldwin’s Advice on Writing
articles.highlight: 才华微不足道。我见过许多有才华的废墟。超越才华的是那些寻常字眼：自律、爱、运气，但最重要的是忍耐。
articles.summary: 这篇文章呈现詹姆斯·鲍德温关于写作的建议：天赋并不重要，真正支撑创作的是自律、爱、运气，以及最重要的忍耐。它值得一读，因为它把创作从天赋神话拉回到长期坚持与日常品格，对写作者和长期创作者都有提醒价值。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发：与其迷信天赋，不如重视自律、热爱与耐力，因为能否长期走下去往往比起点更重要。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "Talent is insignificant. I know a lot of talented ruins. Beyond talent lie all the usual words: discipline, love, luck, but most of all, endurance."

articles.highlight: 脑电基础模型常以固定通道词表或有限导联布局预训练，电极布局变化时迁移困难；CortexBridge 是一种轻量适配器，用于皮层对齐。
articles.summary: 该工作关注脑电基础模型在电极布局变化时的迁移难题。作者提出 CortexBridge，一种轻量适配器，将脑电特征与皮层对齐相结合。摘要显示其目标是让固定通道词表或有限导联集预训练的模型适应新蒙太奇，但全文细节尚未提供。
articles.failureAnalysis: 目前仅有摘要信息，适配器如何结合脑电特征、如何实现皮层对齐及实验验证均未呈现。因此对其跨导联迁移效果和泛化能力应持保留态度。
articles.sourceExcerpt: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models Jiazhen Hong1 Xiaotian Zhou1 Zihao Ding1 Kailong Wang1 Yu Wu1 1Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Rutgers University Piscataway, NJ 08854, USA Abstract Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations.

zh.summary: 该工作关注脑电基础模型在电极布局变化时的迁移难题。作者提出 CortexBridge，一种轻量适配器，将脑电特征与皮层对齐相结合。摘要显示其目标是让固定通道词表或有限导联集预训练的模型适应新蒙太奇，但全文细节尚未提供。
zh.failureAnalysis: 目前仅有摘要信息，适配器如何结合脑电特征、如何实现皮层对齐及实验验证均未呈现。因此对其跨导联迁移效果和泛化能力应持保留态度。

en.title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
en.highlight: EEG foundation models pretrained on fixed channel vocabularies or limited montages struggle to transfer when electrode layouts change; CortexBridge is a lightweight adapter for cortical alignment.
en.summary: This work addresses transfer difficulty in EEG foundation models when electrode layouts change. The authors propose CortexBridge, described as a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features for cortical alignment. The supplied abstract indicates an aim to adapt models pretrained with fixed channel vocabularies or limited montage sets, but full details and validation are not included.
en.failureAnalysis: Only the abstract is available, so how the adapter combines EEG features, performs cortical alignment, and is evaluated remains unspecified. Claims about cross-montage transfer and generalization therefore require further evidence.

articles.title: Inside-Out AI: Rebuilding Airbnb Behind the Scenes and Across the Guest Experience
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 这篇文章讲述曾主导 Meta Llama 系列模型的高管 Ahmad Al-Dahle 加入 Airbnb 后，如何把 AI 同时用在两处：一是改变内部团队的做产品方式，二是改变面向房客的服务体验。它值得一读，因为它给出的不是单点模型实验，而是一个成熟消费平台「由内而外」推进 AI 的思路样本。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启发是：真正落地的 AI 转型往往要同时动内部生产方式与外部用户体验，只做其中一头很难形成合力。
articles.highlight: 在领导 Meta 的 Llama 模型之后，Ahmad Al-Dahle 正在用 AI 改造 Airbnb——从团队如何开发产品，到如何服务房客。
articles.sourceExcerpt: After leading Meta’s Llama models, Ahmad Al-Dahle is now transforming Airbnb with AI — from how its teams develop products to how it serves guests.

en.highlight: After leading Meta's Llama models, Ahmad Al-Dahle is now transforming Airbnb with AI — from how its teams develop products to how it serves guests.
en.summary: This piece covers how Ahmad Al-Dahle, who previously led Meta's Llama models, is now applying AI at Airbnb in two places at once: how internal teams build products, and how guests are served. It is worth reading because it offers a sample of an 'inside-out' AI strategy at a mature consumer platform, rather than a single isolated model experiment.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway: a real AI transformation usually has to change both internal ways of working and the external user experience; doing only one side rarely creates compounding momentum.
